name: Easy Run
description: Run at a conversational pace with relaxed shoulders and short, comfortable strides.

name: Jogging
description: Jog at a relaxed pace, keeping your breathing controlled and your steps light.

name: Long-Distance Run
description: Maintain a sustainable pace over a longer distance; start conservatively and hydrate as needed.

name: Tempo Run
description: Warm up, run at a comfortably hard pace where speaking is limited to short phrases, then cool down.

name: Running Intervals
description: Alternate faster running intervals with easy jogging or walking recovery; repeat for the planned rounds.

name: Sprint Training
description: After a thorough warm-up, accelerate over a short distance, decelerate safely, and recover fully before the next sprint.

name: Hill Running
description: Run uphill with a slight forward lean and powerful arm drive; walk or jog down carefully to recover.

name: Trail Running
description: Follow the trail, shorten steps on uneven ground, scan ahead, and adjust pace to terrain.

name: Shuttle Run
description: Run between marked points, lower your center of gravity before each turn, and change direction under control.

name: Brisk Walking
description: Walk at a purposeful pace with an upright posture and natural arm swing.

name: Power Walking
description: Walk quickly with active arm movement and strong, comfortable steps without breaking into a run.

name: Hiking
description: Walk along a suitable route, use steady steps on climbs and descents, and take water breaks.

name: Stair Climbing
description: Climb at a steady pace, place your whole foot securely on each step, and use the railing for balance when needed.

name: Freestyle Swimming
description: Keep your body streamlined, rotate through the torso, alternate arm pulls, and exhale steadily underwater.

name: Breaststroke Swimming
description: Pull the arms in a coordinated sweep, recover the legs with a frog kick, and glide between strokes.

name: Backstroke Swimming
description: Float on your back, rotate your shoulders, alternate arm strokes, and kick continuously from the hips.

name: Butterfly Swimming
description: Use a rhythmic dolphin kick and coordinated arm recovery; begin with short lengths and rest between efforts.

name: Sidestroke Swimming
description: Stay on your side, coordinate the scissor kick with the arm pull, and glide between strokes.

name: Water Jogging
description: Jog in chest-deep water or with a flotation belt, maintain an upright posture, and move your arms naturally.

name: Kickboard Swim
description: Hold the kickboard lightly, keep your face in a comfortable position, and kick from the hips with relaxed ankles.

name: Shadow Boxing
description: Adopt a balanced boxing stance, move lightly, and practice controlled punches with guard returning to position.

name: Heavy Bag Boxing
description: Wrap your hands and use gloves, practice controlled combinations, keep your wrists aligned, and reset your stance after each combination.

name: Speed Bag Training
description: Strike the speed bag with relaxed, alternating hands in a steady rhythm while keeping your shoulders loose.

name: Boxing Footwork Drills
description: Practice forward, backward, and lateral steps while maintaining stance width and balance; avoid crossing your feet.

name: Boxing Focus-Mitt Drills
description: Work with a trained partner or coach, respond to pad cues, use controlled combinations, and return to guard.

name: Boxing Conditioning
description: Complete timed rounds of boxing footwork, shadow boxing, bag work, and active recovery at a manageable intensity.

name: Kickboxing Training
description: Practice punches and kicks with controlled technique, stable balance, and adequate space; use pads or a bag for impact work.

name: Muay Thai Training
description: Practice stance, footwork, and coach-guided punches, kicks, knees, and elbows using appropriate protective equipment.

name: Karate Kata Practice
description: Perform a kata sequence with controlled stances, deliberate transitions, and precise technique.

name: Taekwondo Drills
description: Practice balance, footwork, and controlled kicking drills with adequate space and a suitable warm-up.

name: Martial Arts Footwork
description: Move through forward, backward, lateral, and pivot steps while maintaining posture and balance.

name: Road Cycling
description: Ride with a stable posture, smooth pedal strokes, and awareness of traffic and road conditions.

name: Stationary Cycling
description: Adjust the seat to a comfortable height, pedal smoothly, and keep resistance appropriate to your fitness level.

name: Indoor Cycling Class
description: Follow the instructor's cadence and resistance cues, stay seated or stand only with stable control, and hydrate.

name: Cycling Intervals
description: Alternate challenging pedaling intervals with easy recovery periods, keeping cadence and resistance controlled.

name: Mountain Biking
description: Choose a trail matching your skill, keep knees and elbows slightly bent, and scan ahead for obstacles.

name: Recumbent Bike
description: Adjust the seat so the knee remains slightly bent at the far pedal position and pedal at a steady pace.

name: Jump Rope Intervals
description: Alternate short rope-skipping rounds with rest or slow marching; progress duration gradually.

name: Stair Climber Machine
description: Step at a controlled pace, keep your torso upright, and avoid supporting your body weight on the rails.

name: Rowing Intervals
description: Row hard for the planned interval, then row lightly or rest; maintain technique as fatigue builds.

name: Football (Soccer)
description: Warm up with easy jogging and ball touches, then practice passing, dribbling, and game play with appropriate footwear.

name: Basketball
description: Combine dribbling, passing, shooting, and game play; land from jumps with knees aligned and take recovery breaks.

name: Tennis
description: Practice footwork and controlled strokes, warm up the shoulder, and use court shoes for traction.

name: Badminton
description: Use short split steps, move efficiently to the shuttle, and practice clears, drops, and smashes with controlled form.

name: Volleyball
description: Practice serving, passing, setting, and controlled jumps; land softly and keep adequate space from other players.

name: Pickleball
description: Use short controlled steps, practice serves and rallies, and maintain a comfortable ready position.

name: Table Tennis
description: Stay light on your feet, practice controlled forehand and backhand strokes, and use short lateral movements.

name: Dance Aerobics
description: Follow the choreography at your own pace, use low-impact steps when needed, and keep movements controlled.

name: Zumba
description: Follow the instructor's dance combinations, modify jumps as needed, and maintain a pace that lets you recover.

name: Step Aerobics
description: Step fully onto the platform, keep the platform stable, and use a height appropriate to your ability.

name: High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)
description: Alternate brief work intervals with recovery, select movements you can perform safely, and stop if form deteriorates.

name: Circuit Training
description: Move through a planned series of exercises with short rests, using manageable loads and maintaining good technique.

name: Cross-Training Session
description: Combine different training modes such as cycling, rowing, strength work, and mobility to vary the session.

name: Burpee Conditioning
description: Squat down, place hands on the floor, step or jump to plank, return to squat, and stand or jump; choose a low-impact version as needed.

name: Agility Ladder Drills
description: Move through ladder patterns with quick, light steps, keeping your eyes forward and progressing only when foot placement is controlled.

name: Sledgehammer Conditioning
description: Use a secure tire and clear area, grip the tool firmly, alternate controlled strikes, and stop before technique breaks down.

name: Kayaking
description: Wear a properly fitted life jacket, use smooth torso rotation with each paddle stroke, and kayak in suitable conditions.

name: Outdoor Rowing
description: Follow the coach or boat safety guidance, drive with the legs, and coordinate the stroke with the crew.

name: Roller Skating
description: Wear protective gear, practice balance and stopping first, and skate on a smooth area free of traffic.

name: Ice Skating
description: Wear appropriate protective gear, keep knees softly bent, and practice balance and stopping near the rink barrier.

name: Yoga Flow
description: Move between poses with steady breathing, avoid forcing range of motion, and use blocks or modifications when needed.

name: Mat Pilates
description: Move slowly with controlled breathing, maintain trunk alignment, and choose variations that suit your ability.

name: Full-Body Mobility Flow
description: Move joints through comfortable ranges with slow controlled repetitions and no painful forcing.

name: Foam Rolling
description: Roll slowly over muscle tissue, pause briefly on comfortable areas of tension, and avoid rolling directly over joints or sharp pain.

name: Boxing Bag Rounds
description: Complete timed bag rounds with controlled combinations, maintain your guard, and rest between rounds.

name: Swimming Laps
description: Swim repeat lengths at a sustainable pace with planned rests; choose a stroke and distance that match your ability.

name: Open-Water Swimming
description: Swim with a buddy or supervised group, use a visible swim buoy, check water conditions, and stay within safe designated areas.

name: Boxing Sparring (Supervised)
description: Only spar under qualified supervision with agreed intensity, mouthguard, gloves, and protective gear; prioritize defense and safety.

name: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) Drills
description: Practice technique drills with a qualified coach, appropriate protective equipment, and controlled intensity; avoid unsupervised contact.
